title: AJC I-44 Winter Shootout
seo_title: AJC I-44 Winter Shootout Indoor Kart Racing in Lebanon, MO
description: The AJC I-44 Winter Shootout is an indoor kart racing event where you can watch practice sessions, heats, qualifying races, and open tire competition over two days. It takes place at the Cowan Civic Center, 500 East Elm Street in Lebanon, MO, starting Saturday, December 26, 2026 at 8:00 AM.
